# Banc of California Names Taylor Brodarick as Head of Investor Relations


**Company Release - 11/16/2026**


## **Brodarick joins as Senior Vice President to lead investor and analyst outreach and communication**


LOS ANGELES–Nov. 16, 2026– Banc of California, a wholly owned subsidiary of Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC), announced today that Taylor Brodarick has joined as Senior Vice President and Head of Investor Relations. He will lead Banc of California’s investor relations strategy, which includes deepening relationships with current and prospective investors and research analysts, and communicating the bank’s financial performance and business strategy. He will also work closely with the executive leadership team to develop and execute strategies to enhance long-term shareholder value and support the bank’s growth initiatives. Brodarick is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, and reports to Joe Kauder, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.


“Taylor brings deep banking industry knowledge and a valuable combination of investor relations and equity research experience to Banc of California,” said Kauder. “His experience building relationships with institutional investors and sell-side analysts will help us broaden our engagement with the investment community. He understands how investors evaluate banks and will help us communicate our performance, growth strategy and approach to creating long-term shareholder value.”


He joins Banc of California from Western Alliance Bancorporation, where he served for the past four years as Investor Relations and Corporate Development Director. In that role, he led investor engagement, developed earnings and investor communications, and advised senior executives on strategic and capital markets matters. He was recently recognized by Extel as a top-10 IR professional among mid-cap banks for 2026. Previously, he held equity research roles at Hovde Group and Guggenheim Securities, covering banks and other financial services companies.


He has an MBA from Vanderbilt University’s Owen Graduate School of Management and a bachelor’s degree in history from Dartmouth College.


For a photo of Brodarick, click[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdam.bancofcal.com%2Fasset%2F43713b40-31c0-4503-98f8-9fa740e4dd86%2FBrodarick_Taylor.jpg&esheet=54641156&newsitemid=20261116778073&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=8e193386f6f47500909a8d27ccc2cabe) .


#### About Banc of California, Inc.


Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. Banc of California is one of the nation’s premier relationship-based business banks, providing banking and treasury management services to small, middle-market, and venture-backed businesses. Through its Private Banking division, the bank also serves individuals and families with personalized banking solutions, dedicated relationship management, and exceptional service. Banc of California is the largest publicly-traded bank headquartered in Los Angeles and the third largest bank headquartered in California and offers a broad range of loan and deposit products and services through 76 full-service branches located throughout California and in Denver, Colorado, and Durham, North Carolina, as well as through regional offices nationwide. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide with its technology-forward platform, SmartStreet™. The bank is committed to its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation, and by supporting organizations that provide financial literacy and job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more. ## Banc of California, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Diluted Earnings per Share of $0.46, Up 21% Year Over Year


Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) (“Banc of California” or the “Company”), the parent company of wholly-owned subsidiary Banc of California (the “Bank”), today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported net earnings available to common and equivalent stockholders of $73.1 million, or $0.46 per diluted common share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $59.7 million, or $0.38 per diluted common share for the third quarter of 2025. For the second quarter of 2026, the Company reported a net loss available to common and equivalent stockholders of $251.3 million, or $(1.61) per diluted common share, reflecting the previously announced strategic balance sheet repositioning.
